title: Ten Days of Diesel

mood.label: Grinding, nothing new fell
mood.summary: Forty out of a hundred on a grinding Sunday: Nepal's flood toll at 675 with 2,500 missing, a crushed mutiny in Niamey, Zaporizhzhia on generators, a Gaza hospital warehouse hit. The counterweights - Iceland, Palau, a CAR T-cell result - are procedural, not joyful.

lines: Four days on, the valley hands its numbers back:
six hundred seventy-five found, two and a half thousand not.
In Niamey the young officers moved before the light,
and state TV read out what the barracks cost.
A reactor runs on diesel in its second week,
ten days of fuel and someone watching the gauge.
Iceland leans a yes by the width of a hand;
in Palau the small islands take the stage.
Ten days of diesel, then whatever comes -
forty out of a hundred, the same low hum.
No new disaster; just the old ones running long.
